title: Nice quality towel but they are a bit to small and need a snap loop
text:
Nice quality towel but they are a bit to small and need a snap loop. These are nice quality towels and I really like the different designs and colors but for me they are a bit too small to use as a hand towel.
I thought they had a snap loop, but they don't, so you need a hook to hang them up.
They would be nice as a decorative towel and or for kids.
My grandchildren have a play kitchen and I am going to give the towels to them.
I did read the information about the size, but since I didn't get out a measuring tape to see what size they would be, I ordered them anyway as I liked the colors and designs and I hoped they would be large enough for me to use.

product_metadata.title: Fun Kitchen and Bath Towels 3pk
description: Go ahead and add a some character and fun to your kitchen with these luxurious and super absorbent kitchen towels. Made from 100% cotton, they feature a waffle style texture and are enhanced with colorful embroidery that livens up any kitchen and creates a conversation piece. The round shape and hanging loop allows for easy hanging off of cupboards or kitchen towel hooks for easy access and drying. These towels are 100% machine washable and are built to last. Three different designs are included as shown.
